{{- /* Hextra's components/codeblock partial, with three changes. The language is the fence's info string up to its first comma. A powershell block holding a session, a line that starts with "PS> ", is highlighted line by line. A command, from its "PS> " line through the ">> " lines that continue it, is highlighted as PowerShell after its prompts, and every other line is shown as output. Every documented command is run by tools/Invoke-Documentation.ps1, so a token the lexer marks as an error inside one is the lexer's limit, not the command's, and is shown as plain text. The shader code in a powershell block is highlighted in its own language. The slots tools/Export-ShaderSlots.ps1 lists for the block in data/shader_slots.json are swapped for placeholders before the block is highlighted, and each placeholder is then replaced by its code as Chroma highlights it in the slot's language, WGSL or GLSL. Each slot is one line, highlighted with its line end, which Chroma's WGSL lexer needs to end a // comment, and the line end is then taken off. A powershell block the file has no entry for stops the build. */ -}} {{ $filename := .filename | default "" -}} {{ $base_url := .base_url | default "" -}} {{ $lang := .lang | default "" }} {{ $content := .content }} {{ $options := .options | default (dict) }} {{- if $filename -}}
{{- if $base_url -}} {{- $base_url = strings.TrimSuffix "/" $base_url -}} {{- $filename = strings.TrimPrefix "/" $filename -}} {{- $file_url := urls.JoinPath $base_url $filename -}} {{- $filename -}} {{- partial "utils/icon" (dict "name" "external-link" "attributes" "height=1em") -}} {{- else -}} {{- $filename -}} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- $lang = index (split $lang ",") 0 -}} {{- $content = replace $content "\r" "" -}} {{- $slot_html := slice -}} {{- if eq $lang "powershell" -}} {{- $key := md5 (strings.TrimRight "\n" $content) -}} {{- $table := hugo.Data.shader_slots | default dict -}} {{- if not (isset $table $key) -}} {{- errorf "data/shader_slots.json has no entry for the powershell block that starts %q: run tools/Export-ShaderSlots.ps1" (index (split $content "\n") 0) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $masked := "" -}} {{- $at := 0 -}} {{- range $i, $slot := index $table $key -}} {{- $start := int (index $slot 0) -}} {{- $end := int (index $slot 1) -}} {{- $masked = printf "%s%sWGPUSLOT%dX" $masked (substr $content $at (sub $start $at)) $i -}} {{- $code := substr $content $start (sub $end $start) -}} {{- $html := replaceRE `^]*>|$` "" (string (highlight (printf "%s\n" $code) (index $slot 2) (dict "hl_inline" true))) -}} {{- $html = replaceRE `\n$` "" $html -}} {{- $html = replaceRE `\n((?:)*)$` "$1" $html -}} {{- $slot_html = $slot_html | append $html -}} {{- $at = $end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $content = printf "%s%s" $masked (substr $content $at) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $lines := split $content "\n" -}} {{- if and (gt (len $lines) 0) (eq (index $lines (sub (len $lines) 1)) "") -}} {{- $lines = first (sub (len $lines) 1) $lines -}} {{- end -}} {{- $session := false -}} {{- if eq $lang "powershell" -}} {{- range $lines -}} {{- if hasPrefix . "PS> " -}}{{- $session = true -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if $session -}} {{- $out := slice -}} {{- $command := "" -}} {{- $open := false -}} {{- $n := len $lines -}} {{- range $i, $line := $lines -}} {{- $next := "" -}} {{- if lt (add $i 1) $n -}}{{- $next = index $lines (add $i 1) -}}{{- end -}} {{- if hasPrefix $line "PS> " -}} {{- $command = strings.TrimPrefix "PS> " $line -}} {{- $open = true -}} {{- else if and $open (hasPrefix $line ">> ") -}} {{- $command = printf "%s\n%s" $command (strings.TrimPrefix ">> " $line) -}} {{- else -}} {{- $open = false -}} {{- $html := "" -}} {{- if $line -}}{{- $html = printf `%s` (htmlEscape $line) -}}{{- end -}} {{- $out = $out | append (printf "%s\n" $html) -}} {{- end -}} {{- if and $open (not (hasPrefix $next ">> ")) -}} {{- $tokens := "" -}} {{- if $command -}} {{- $tokens = replaceRE `^]*>|$` "" (string (highlight $command "powershell" (dict "hl_inline" true))) -}} {{- $tokens = replaceRE `([^<]*)` "$1" $tokens -}} {{- $tokens = replace $tokens "\n" "\n>> " -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out = $out | append (printf "PS> %s\n" $tokens) -}} {{- $open = false -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $html := delimit $out "" -}} {{- range $i, $h := $slot_html -}}{{- $html = replace $html (printf "WGPUSLOT%dX" $i) $h -}}{{- end -}} 
{{ $html | safeHTML }}
{{- else if transform.CanHighlight $lang -}} {{- $html := string (highlight $content $lang $options) -}} {{- range $i, $h := $slot_html -}}{{- $html = replace $html (printf "WGPUSLOT%dX" $i) $h -}}{{- end -}}
{{- $html | safeHTML -}}
{{- else -}} 
{{ $content }}
{{- end -}}
